83-type signature corresponding to InsDel3a (C_ID3)

Note

WARNING: The 83-type signature C_ID3 corresponds to both InsDel3a and InsDel3b. The C_ID3 extraction mainly excluded T deletions in long poly-T contexts that were detected in InsDel3a in extractions in both the 89-type and 476-type classifications, but not in the InsDel3b extractions. Thus, C_ID3 corresponds more closely to InsDel3b than to InsDel3a

83-type signature converted from signature discovered in the 476-type spectra (using bipartite matching optimization) | cosine similarity to C_ID3: 0.9454

Click to see flow diagrams: 476-type to 83-type collapse

These Sankey diagrams show how the 476-type mutation categories are redistributed to 83-type categories using bipartite matching. We only show the diagrams for insertions or deletions of > 1 base because it is for these indels that 476-type categories map to > 1 83-type category.
